zh.summary: 该条目来自arXiv，标题为《非反应性烧结提升NASICON固态电解质的密度和离子电导率》。已知信息仅包括作者列表及其所属机构，如德国联邦材料研究与测试机构（BAM）和柏林洪堡大学等。若结论成立，非反应性烧结可能为NASICON固态电解质致密化与导电性能优化提供思路。
zh.failureAnalysis: 当前提供的源文本仅为标题和作者机构信息，缺少摘要、实验数据与表征结果，无法验证烧结方法对密度和离子电导率的具体提升幅度。因此只能视为标题层面的研究线索，不能据此判断其普适性或实际性能。

Thus it cannot verify how much non-reactive sintering improves density or ionic conductivity, nor whether the effect is broadly applicable.

articles.title: Human-Agent-Society/reef
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: 这是一个名为 Reef 的开源项目，定位是为「能自我改进的智能体」提供持续学习（continual learning）所需的基础设施，目前在 GitHub 上获得 3038 颗星，且近期仍有公开活跃度。它值得关注的地方在于：持续学习是让智能体在生产环境中不断积累经验、而不是每次从零开始的关键工程环节，而这一层能力通常缺乏通用、可复用的底座。
articles.failureAnalysis: 需求真实性有待验证：给智能体做「持续学习」听起来必要，但多数落地场景目前靠离线重训加提示工程就能应付，未必愿意为额外的基础设施买单。工程与成本约束很重：持续学习要处理灾难性遗忘、数据回流、版本回滚与算力开销，任何一环做得不稳都会让使用者退回更简单的方案。此外该项目仅凭星数和描述被看到，缺少可验证的规模化部署案例与商业化路径，长期维护的持续投入也存在不确定性。

en.highlight: Continual learning infrastructure for self-improving agents — the repo has drawn 3,038 stars on GitHub.
en.summary: Reef is an open-source project positioned as infrastructure for continual learning in self-improving agents, currently at 3,038 GitHub stars with recent public activity. It matters because continual learning is the layer that lets agents accumulate experience in production instead of restarting from scratch, and that layer is usually missing as a reusable base.
en.failureAnalysis: Real demand is unproven, since most deployments still get by with offline retraining and prompt engineering rather than paying for extra infrastructure. Continual learning also carries heavy engineering costs — catastrophic forgetting, data pipelines, rollback, and compute — so any instability pushes users back to simpler approaches.
en.title: Reef: Continual Learning Infrastructure for Self-Improving Agents
